name: AR6
source_name: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report, WG1 Chapter 7 (Table 7.15; SF6 from Table 7.SM.7), 100-year GWP including carbon-cycle response
notes: Read from the published tables on 2026-09-25. Table 7.15 separates fossil from non-fossil methane and includes the chemical adjustments; the supplementary Table 7.SM.7 does not, which is why its methane value of 27.9 differs. SF6 is not in Table 7.15 and is taken from Table 7.SM.7 (https://www.ipcc.ch/report/ar6/wg1/downloads/report/IPCC_AR6_WGI_Chapter07_SM.pdf).
